Eva: Quick sync — we need to lock the Optimize toolkit sprint scope today. Main asks: batching heuristics, prefix/KV caching recs, quantization guidance, and eval-triggered alerting. Who can take lead on acceptance criteria?
Mike: I can own batching + perf targets. quick question: do we want a single unified SLA or per-workload bands?
Sami: per-workload bands, otherwise quant recs will be too noisy. for critical low-latency flows target p99 < 150ms on dedicated, and cost delta < 20% vs baseline.
Eva: noted. so batch & cache targets: p50/p95/p99 and token-cost % reduction goals. Mike — propose numbers, we'll iterate.
Jordan: for eval-triggered alerts we should define signal thresholds: e.g., >5% drop in normalized BLEU/ROUGE or >3% increase in hallucination rate over 24h. prefer precision-first to reduce noise.
Clara: from UX side we need clear alert templates and remediation steps in Console. also need mockup for alert card + triage links.
Mike: rough batching targets for sprint: reduce per-token CPU by 18% (p95), p99 latency target for batched gen 200ms on medium sequences. will validate w/bench.
Sami: quant rec guidance: recommend 4-bit PTQ for most CPU-hosted models, with fallback to 8-bit if eval delta > 2% on quality suite. include a scripted eval harness: `scripts/quant-check --model $M --evalset core_prompts`.
Eva: acceptance criteria proposal (high level):
• Core: batching + caching produce >=15% unit cost improvement on 3 canonical workloads with p99 within target band.
• Quant: automated guardrails and rollback path; quality regression <=2% on eval suite.
• Alerts: false positive rate <10% in pilot, actionable playbook in Console.
Jordan: pilot customers? recommend 2: ShopLoop (high QPS chat) and DocScribe (long context embedding). both volunteered in earlier survey.
Clara: timeline check — can design mockups for alert card by Wed. need final copy for playbook.
Mike: blockers — need up-to-date perf matrix from eng-runtime (kernel mapping) and access to ShopLoop traces. Sami — can you own eval harness and quality threshold tooling?
Sami: I can. will add a small dashboard for drift + sample diffs.
Eva: risks: rollout noise (alerts), model-specific quant regressions, and customer infra differences. mitigation: staged rollout (alpha->beta->ga) + automated canary job that runs on each model variant.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for `optimize-toolkit/alpha` — build 2026.03.21a — logs: https://ci.redwood/optimize/20260321a
Mike: thanks. next steps: I'll post a PR with numeric SLOs and perf targets by EOD. Sami will create eval harness repo and seed tests. Clara will drop mockups. Eva will draft pilot onboarding checklist + playbook text.
Eva: if no objections I'll close the scope by EOD and unblock sprint planning. please react here with :+1: / :-1: to record consensus.
Jordan: +1
Mike: +1
Sami: +1
Clara: +1
Eva: thanks team — will follow up with the final spec in this thread.
